label: A_s1_draft
prompt:
SHOT: medium-wide, eye level, 35mm at T2.8, camera follows one metre behind him at walking pace and stops when he stops, 25 fps.
SUBJECT AND ACTION: seen from behind, a man in a navy suit with an open shirt collar walks through an open glass door, stops at the head of a long table, rests both hands on an empty chair and says in German: "Ich habe etwas zu berichten." The seven people at the table turn toward him; two raise their eyebrows.
PEOPLE: five men and two women aged forty to sixty-five, grey and dark suits, open collars, ordinary office faces.
PLACE: long walnut table, closed folders and water glasses, floor-to-ceiling window with a view over the rooftops of Vienna.
LIGHT: soft overcast daylight from the window, about 4:1, ceiling lights on, expose to protect the highlights.
COLOUR: navy, grey and walnut, natural skin.
SOUND: low string pulse under quiet room tone, footsteps on carpet, then his line. Only he speaks.

SHOT: close shot from the side at table height, 50mm lens, static.
PLACE: a light oak meeting table, a closed grey notebook far out of focus, a water glass.
LIGHT: soft daylight from a window camera-left, about 4:1.
